source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Applying mainly to clients who have undergone a cesarean delivery, rather than to postpartum clients following any delivery type","B":"Resting on a fairly weak or poorly established body of supporting clinical evidence at the present time","C":"Provides a standardized, stepwise response including specific interventions, staff roles, and escalation criteria to ensure rapid, coordinated care","D":"Holding off on any active intervention entirely until the physician has been able to physically arrive at the client's bedside"}}
source_row.rationale: Standardized obstetric hemorrhage protocols provide a stepwise response including specific interventions, defined staff roles, and escalation criteria, ensuring rapid, coordinated care shown to improve outcomes in postpartum hemorrhage.
source_row.source_name: AWHONN / ACOG — Postpartum Hemorrhage Safety Bundle
